policy: References informed polyp proportions (disc diameter, column width and height, tentacle count and length, mouth shape), colony layout and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, tracing or proportion source; the trade name 'zoanthid colony' is resolved to genus level (Zoanthus sp.) because aquarium colonies are rarely identified to species.

referenceGradeRationale: Published descriptions give measured column, disc, mouth and tentacle proportions for the type species, and openly licensed colony photographs exist for top and oblique views. Captive colonies are not identified to species and their column height varies with light, so column height and disc-to-column ratio are a genus-level compromise rather than a calibrated species measurement.
